argument: char pointer at [ESP+4]; cdecl RET without immediate
result: EAX is the byte distance from the argument pointer to the first NUL within the admitted mapped string
registers: ECX is restored to the argument pointer; EDX is unchanged on early unaligned-byte exits and becomes 0x7efefeff plus the last scanned word modulo 2^32 on word-scan exits; ESP advances four bytes; EBX, EBP, ESI and EDI are preserved
memory: No writes; initial four-byte argument read, one-byte reads until alignment, four-byte aligned scan, optional four-byte reread on detector candidate, four-byte argument reread and four-byte return-address read
scan_word_detector: ((~word ^ (word + 0x7efefeff)) & 0x81010100) != 0; candidate word is reread and tested bytewise
admitted_domain: Stable synthetic 104-byte source regions with first NUL at selected offsets 0..95, all four pointer alignments and four nonzero fill patterns; all performed reads and 36-byte stack region mapped and disjoint; no code patch or intercepted callee
boundaries: Unmapped/faulting pointers and page crossings are not modeled.
Concurrent source mutation, source/stack aliasing and 32-bit address wrapping are outside the domain.
The R24 formatter, locale-aware copy callers and their output remain unvalidated here.
EFLAGS and elapsed timing are not compared.
